events.title: McMillin Farm European Holiday Market
events.desc:
Free admission, free parking and free entertainment. Bring the whole family!
This year’s theme is Italy, and you can come vote on next year’s country.
12 vendors of Christmas will be selling great holiday gifts.
The Tahoma Troupe, a hand bell group, will perform holiday music.
Krampus and Santa & Mrs. Claus will be there for photo ops.
The Brewhouse will be open for all your beverage needs.
Three fully decorated Christmas trees and three weekend getaway packages will be raffled off to support Celebrate HARVEST again this year.
Come enjoy this affordable family event and get into the Christmas spirit.
